title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japanese Derby, and I'd love for us to make an impressive entrance onto the track, but…
I remember how Seiun Sky failed to show up to our rendezvous point before the Satsuki Sho.
So I switch to my backup plan…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There ya go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wide awake, just like ya ordered! She's a heavy-duty sleeper, but I'm sure the shock's worn off by now!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Using Hishiama for your own devices… You're too clever, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: If you ask me, it was the perfect job for the Miho Dorm leader! That's what I'm all about!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: From here on, I'll be comin' to wake you up before all your big races. Be prepared!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ugh…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: At least now I can take my time changing clothes and whatnot.
With that, the problem of getting Seiun Sky to the racecourse is resolved. But I'm not finished yet…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, woohoo… I'm with ya…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Not that I know if I can really win this time, but I'll give it a shot.
Woooooo!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wow, check out the crowd. Should've expected this for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The cheers aren't for the Derby alone, but also for the rematch between the big three!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey there, King. Looking great today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I am first-rate! I am never anything less than great!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's why I won't lose to anyone today—not to you, and not to Special Week!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Special Week…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Let's leave her alone. Don't wanna break her focus.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …That's right. Running in the Derby is a dream of hers.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But what about me?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh my god, I'm so excited! Special Week is totally gonna take first place!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: She's been saying she wants to win the Derby for forever. I really want to see her fly past her big three rivals and win!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Would you look at that? Seems like Spe's the favorite to win.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Not a surprise. She's always had her sights on this race.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But that's no reason I can't catch my own dream here.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?
